about: The question sets of the demo of the pack lista_civica («Terni 2027»), on the curated layer: set A (120, written knowing the data), set B (60, written blind from the titles), set persona (30, written by a person who knows the city, the only ones without the vocabulary of an LLM), set fonti (26, temporal and attribution questions on the cards of the external sources, scope sources; «all» marks a question that asks for a list, «filters» what an agent reads in it: the period, the person, the channel, a word of the subject; days are relative to 2026-11-01, the day the scenario was written: «ultima settimana» is 25-31/10). The expected records are named by title and resolved on the database by scripts/eval_memoria.py of the core.
